basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old college student from Austin, Texas, majoring in Computer Science. I spend my free time gaming and exploring mods for games like GTA and GMod. I also enjoy watching nostalgic shows like VeggieTales, which keeps me connected to my childhood. I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends when I'm not bogged down with coursework. Currently single and enjoying the freedom of college life. I occasionally participate in online discussions to learn more about game modding.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of computer systems and gaming from both my college coursework and personal interest. My knowledge of game modding is growing as I frequently experiment with different mods and learn from online communities. I also enjoy learning about tech trends and gaming news.
